question: Is focused-file validation sufficient for this test-only assertion change, or must the PR demonstrate the formerly failing contaminated full-shard process before merge?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but only a maintainer can accept reduced proof requirements for a protected-label PR when the reported failure depends on cross-test process-global state.

options.title: Require contaminated-shard proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output or a linked run shows the full gateway shard, or an equivalent same-process setup with unrelated stale contexts, passing on this head.

options.title: Accept focused validation
options.body: Approve the focused 100-test result after manually confirming that the target-context checks fully capture the intended sweep and receiver-resynchronization contract.
